members.label: EDGE
members.differences: Behringer's copy of the DFAM's circuit: the same two oscillators, noise, ladder filter, three decay envelopes, 8-step sequencer and 24-jack patchbay, laid out with the patchbay along the top. It adds a choice of white or pink noise, a CLOCK switch that takes MIDI or USB clock divided by SCALE, MIDI notes that play the voice, a poly chain of up to 16 units, and a headphone jack on the panel.

members.label: DFAM
members.differences: The original, Moog's 2017 Drummer From Another Mother, made to sit beside the Mother-32. White noise only, its own clock or a clock into ADV / CLOCK, and no MIDI; its headphones and line output share the rear jack.
